summary: 14 blocking findings: 9 backed (1 reference fix, 8 coverage/guard), 5 disputed with GNU ed receipts (2, 3, 4, 9, 13). Instruction and environment unchanged.

findings.summary: Bounded-repeat run memo reused across search starts with a back-reference.
findings.rationale: Real. The finding's script prints ? instead of aX (receipts/returned/crs-reproduction.json, f1). posixre.py now skips the offered-run memo when the pattern holds a back-reference, and rejects a back-reference to a group that is not yet closed (a sibling found by the sweep). Back-reference differential of 3,000 patterns vs GNU ed: 19 disagreements before, 0 after (work/fuzz-*-safebr.json); 4,000 patterns without back-references: 0. Two committed cases pin it; the returned reference as a submission scores 1 on the returned verifier and 0 on the repaired one.

gate.rule: wrong path backref-run-memo-shared must fail test_regex (manifest wrong_paths, regression suite)
